availability.morphology_illustration: One source-qualified S1 final-particle outline; other contexts retain source images and explicit geometry missingness. No sample crystal, shell/interface or finite-particle atomic model.

bindings.caption: Prepare and stir TOP-Se in the glovebox. Stir until clear; amounts, duration and temperature are not reported. Generic conceptual vessel; source does not specify vessel dimensions, neck count, liquid level or apparatus geometry.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
